title: Quick start
text: Given vector age group labels, extract lower limits, upper limits, midpoints, widths: Use lower limit filter rows: age_mid() useful plotting.
code: library(agetime)  x <- c("0", "1-4", "5-9", "10+") age_lower(x) #>   0 1-4 5-9 10+  #>   0   1   5  10 age_upper(x) #>   0 1-4 5-9 10+  #>   1   5  10 Inf age_mid(x) #>    0  1-4  5-9  10+  #>  0.5  3.0  7.5 12.0 age_width(x) #>   0 1-4 5-9 10+  #>   1   4   5 Inf library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)  df <- tibble(   age   = c("0-14", "15-64", "65+"),   count = c(100, 200, 50) )  df |>   filter(age_lower(age) >= 15) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 15-64   200 #> 2 65+      50

title: Quick start
text: agetime understands open intervals totals.
code: df <- tibble(   age   = c("15-64", "0-14", "65+", "All"),   count = c(5, 2, 6, 13) )  df |>   filter(!age_is_total(age)) #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 15-64     5 #> 2 0-14      2 #> 3 65+       6  df |>   filter(age_is_open(age)) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 65+       6

what: Work with Age, Period, and Cohort Labels
title: Work with Age, Period, and Cohort Labels
text: Work age, period, cohort labels. Functions cleaning, validating, extracting information, modifying, creating new labels. Example: standardizing labels. Example: filtering age. See ?agetime full list functions grouped task.
code: library(agetime)  x <-  c("2003 to 2005", "2012--2015", "2000-2005")  x |>   period_standard() #> [1] "2003-2005" "2012-2015" "2000-2005" library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)  df <- data.frame(   age = c("0-14", "100+", "15-39"),   count = c(100, 40, 200) )     df |>   filter(age_lower(age) >= 15) #>     age count #> 1  100+    40 #> 2 15-39   200

what: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
text: Collect information age group labels (age_check()), throw error age group labels conform expectations (age_assert).

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
code: age_check(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   include_zero = NA,   include_open = NA,   valid_life = NA,   x_fail = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  age_assert(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   include_zero = NA,   include_open = NA,   valid_life = NA,   x_fail = c("error", "warn", "silent") )

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
text: x Vector age group labels. no_overlap age groups overlap. no_gap Age groups span entire range lower limit youngest age group upper limit oldest age group. no_total "Total" age group. no_na NA age group. include_zero One age groups lower limit zero. include_open One age groups upper limit. valid_life labels valid (abridged) life table. x_fail Action element x parsed: "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
text: age_check(), list logical ok data frame details; age_assert(), x invisibly error.

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
code: lab <- age_labels_life() lab #>  [1] "0"     "1-4"   "5-9"   "10-14" "15-19" "20-24" "25-29" "30-34" "35-39" #> [10] "40-44" "45-49" "50-54" "55-59" "60-64" "65-69" "70-74" "75-79" "80-84" #> [19] "85-89" "90-94" "95-99" "100+"   ## get info on everything age_check(   x = lab,   no_overlap = TRUE,   no_gap = TRUE,   no_total = TRUE,   no_na = TRUE,   include_zero = TRUE,   include_open = TRUE,   valid_life = TRUE ) #> $ok #> [1] TRUE #>  #> $details #> # A tibble: 7 × 4 #>   check        asserted observed comment #>   <chr>        <lgl>    <lgl>    <chr>   #> 1 no_overlap   TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 2 no_gap       TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 3 no_total     TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 4 no_na        TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 5 include_zero TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 6 include_open TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #> 7 valid_life   TRUE     TRUE     Passed  #>   ## throw error if gaps age_assert(x = lab, no_gap = TRUE)  lab_gap <- lab[c(1, 3)] ## throw error if no gaps age_assert(x = lab_gap, no_gap = FALSE)

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter age. See examples. age_mid() uses formula age_mid(x) = age_lower(x) + 0.5 * age_width(x), except open age groups, "100+", uses age_mid(x) = age_lower(x) + 0.5 * median_width median_width median closed intervals.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
code: x <- c("5-9", "10-14", "100+") age_lower(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5    10   100  age_upper(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>    10    15   Inf  age_width(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5     5   Inf  age_mid(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>   7.5  12.5 102.5   ## use 'age_lower()' to filter on age library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(   ~age, ~count,   "5-9", 11,   "10-14", 20,   "100+", 7 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 5-9      11 #> 2 10-14    20 #> 3 100+      7 df |> filter(age_lower(age) >= 10) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 10-14    20 #> 2 100+      7  ## no action when 'x_fail' is "silent" age_lower(c("0-4", "young people", "50plus"),   x_fail = "silent" ) #>         0-4 youngpeople         50+  #>           0          NA          50

what: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
text: Create mapping age group labels. mapping depicts relationship labels x labels y. types relationship can mapped : "x equals y" "x contains y" "x contained y" "x overlaps y".

title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
code: age_mapping(   x,   y = NULL,   relation = c("equals", "contains", "is-contained-in", "overlaps-with"),   format = c("tibble", "matrix"),   x_fail = c("error", "warn", "silent") )

title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
text: x Vector age group labels. y Vector age group labels. value supplied, x mapped onto . relation Relationship labels. Choices "equals" (default), "contains", "-contained-", "overlaps-". See details examples. format Format return value. Choices "tibble" (default) "matrix". x_fail Action element x parsed: "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
text: Tibble matrix, depending format.

title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
text: value y supplied, x mapped onto . Tibbles produced age_mapping() sparse include matches. Matrices produced age_mapping() dense include matches non-matches. See example .

title: Mapping Between Age Group Labels — age_mapping
code: x <- c("0-4", "10", "5-7") y <- c("5-9", "0-4", "6-14") age_mapping(x = x, y = y) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 0-4   0-4   age_mapping(x = x, format = "matrix") #>      y #> x     0-4 10 5-7 #>   0-4   1  0   0 #>   10    0  1   0 #>   5-7   0  0   1 age_mapping(x = x, y = y, relation = "contains") #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 0-4   0-4   age_mapping(x = x, y = y, relation = "is-contained-in") #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 5-7   5-9   #> 2 0-4   0-4   #> 3 10    6-14  age_mapping(x = x, y = y, relation = "overlaps-with") #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 5-7   5-9   #> 2 0-4   0-4   #> 3 10    6-14  #> 4 5-7   6-14   # sparse tibble vs dense matrix x <- c("0-4", "10-14") y <- c("0-4", "5-9") age_mapping(x = x, y = y) # one match #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 0-4   0-4   age_mapping(x = x, y = y, format = "matrix") # 1 match, 3 non-matches #>        y #> x       0-4 5-9 #>   0-4     1   0 #>   10-14   0   0  # mapping 'x' on to itself x <- c("0--4", "0-4", "5+") age_mapping(x) #> # A tibble: 5 × 2 #>   x     y     #>   <chr> <chr> #> 1 0--4  0--4  #> 2 0-4   0--4  #> 3 0--4  0-4   #> 4 0-4   0-4   #> 5 5+    5+

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Cohorts — cohort_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter cohorts. See examples.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Cohorts — cohort_lower
code: x <- c("2025-2030", "<2025", "2030-2035") cohort_lower(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>      2025      -Inf      2030  cohort_upper(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>      2030      2025      2035  cohort_width(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>         5       Inf         5  cohort_mid(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>    2027.5    2022.5    2032.5   ## use 'cohort_lower()' to filter on cohort library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(   ~cohort, ~count,   "2025-2030", 20,   "<2025", 5,   "2030-2035", 11 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   cohort    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030    20 #> 2 <2025         5 #> 3 2030-2035    11 df |> filter(cohort_lower(cohort) >= 2025) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   cohort    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030    20 #> 2 2030-2035    11  ## 'x_one' is "lower" (the default) cohort_lower("2025") #> 2025  #> 2025  cohort_upper("2025") #> 2025  #> 2026  cohort_width("2025") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'x_one' is "upper" cohort_lower("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2024  cohort_upper("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2025  cohort_width("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'x_multi' is "include" (the default) cohort_upper("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2030  cohort_width("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>         5   ## 'x_multi' is "exclude" cohort_upper("2025-2030", x_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2031  cohort_width("2025-2030", x_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>         6   ## no action when 'x_fail' is "silent" cohort_lower(c("2000-2005", "long time ago"),   x_fail = "silent" ) #>   2000-2005 longtimeago  #>        2000          NA

Parsing Cohort Labels — parsing_cohort_labels
text: Parameters x_one, x_multi, x_fail control agetime interprets cohort labels.

title: Parsing Cohort Labels — parsing_cohort_labels
text: Parsing one-year labels x_one "lower". Label refers lower limit. instance, "2030" might 1 January 2030 1 January 2031. x_one "upper". Label refers upper limit. instance, "2030" might 30 June 2029 30 June 2030.

title: Parsing Cohort Labels — parsing_cohort_labels
text: Parsing multi-year labels x_multi "include". Label includes upper limit. instance, "2030-2035" might 30 June 2030 30 June 2035. x_multi "exclude". Label excludes upper limit. instance, "2030-2035" might 1 January 2030 1 January 2036.

title: Parsing Cohort Labels — parsing_cohort_labels
text: Action label parsed x_fail "error". Throw error. x_fail "warn". Throw warning. x_fail "silent". Ignore label carry .

title: Parsing Period Labels — parsing_period_labels
text: Parameters x_one, x_multi, x_fail control agetime interprets period labels.

title: Parsing Period Labels — parsing_period_labels
text: Parsing one-year labels x_one "lower". Label refers lower limit. instance, "2030" might 1 January 2030 1 January 2031. x_one "upper". Label refers upper limit. instance, "2030" might 30 June 2029 30 June 2030.

title: Parsing Period Labels — parsing_period_labels
text: Parsing multi-year labels x_multi "include". Label includes upper limit. instance, "2030-2035" might 30 June 2030 30 June 2035. x_multi "exclude". Label excludes upper limit. instance, "2030-2035" might 1 January 2030 1 January 2036.

title: Parsing Period Labels — parsing_period_labels
text: Action label parsed x_fail "error". Throw error. x_fail "warn". Throw warning. x_fail "silent". Ignore label carry .

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter periods. See examples.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
code: x <- c("2025-2030", "2020-2025", "2030-2035") period_lower(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2025      2020      2030  period_upper(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2030      2025      2035  period_width(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>         5         5         5  period_mid(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>    2027.5    2022.5    2032.5   ## use 'period_lower()' to filter on period library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(   ~period, ~count,   "2020-2025", 20,   "2025-2030", 5,   "2030-2035", 11 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2020-2025    20 #> 2 2025-2030     5 #> 3 2030-2035    11 df |> filter(period_lower(period) >= 2025) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030     5 #> 2 2030-2035    11  ## 'x_one' is "lower" (the default) period_lower("2025") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_upper("2025") #> 2025  #> 2026  period_width("2025") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'x_one' is "upper" period_lower("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2024  period_upper("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_width("2025", x_one = "upper") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'x_multi' is "include" (the default) period_upper("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2030  period_width("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>         5   ## 'x_multi' is "exclude" period_upper("2025-2030", x_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2031  period_width("2025-2030", x_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>         6   ## no action when 'x_fail' is "silent" period_lower(c("2000-2005", "long time ago"),   x_fail = "silent" ) #>   2000-2005 longtimeago  #>        2000          NA
